description: Lists the games in a window (tonight, tomorrow, a weekday or a date) for a league or one team, with the highest moneyline price we saw on each side and the time it was scanned. Prices may have moved since the scan.

books.description: The books this person actually has. Omit for the default set.

sport.description: League, e.g. nfl or college football.

text.description: The reader's words, for the window.

when.description: today, tonight, tomorrow, a weekday, weekend, or YYYY-MM-DD. Default the next 24 hours.

name: slate

as_of.description: When the prices were scanned, Eastern Time.

card.description: The same answer, structured, when there is one.

decline_kind.description: Set when the question is one we do not answer, and which kind.

ok.description: True when the tool produced an answer.

options.description: When the question could mean more than one thing: whole questions to ask again with.

stale.description: True when that scan is older than usual for our hourly snapshot.

state_note.description: Where to check what is legal for you.

title: Games on the Schedule
